message: Designer is checking the furniture layout

I couldn’t generate a complete checked preview: the catalog currently lacks a compatible, sized set for the sofa, rug, table, reading light and focal storage.

The direction is warm minimalism: simple upholstered seating, a quiet rug and warm wood, arranged for conversation—not lined-up chairs. Nothing has changed; other rooms remain untouched. Budget is unconfirmed, and an exact cost requires available catalog products.
